presentation_revision_history.prompt: Square premium painterly naturalistic mythology encyclopedia illustration of ENKI, Sumerian freshwater god. Depict the explicit documented iconography: one bearded adult HUMAN MAN in long opaque robes wearing a HORNED CAP; the horns are ornaments of the cap, not skull horns. Dignified quiet standing pose in an ancient mudbrick courtyard by an ordinary water basin, natural warm daylight. Two modest CLEAR WATER STREAMS issue from his shoulders and fall naturally into the basin, the single source-supported supernatural motif. Water looks like real transparent falling water, no colored glow or energy ribbons. Full human anatomy, one head, two arms and hands, long dark beard, ordinary human scale. Presence via thoughtful steady gaze, composed pose, beautiful robe folds, soft natural light, tactile mudbrick and water textures. No additional animals or hybrid anatomy, lightning, luminous mist, generic aura, text or watermark.

visual_review.notes: Inspected native: bearded human man in long robes and cap-mounted horn ornaments. Two clear nonluminous water streams visibly originate at shoulders and fall into a basin. Ordinary human anatomy, calm gaze, natural courtyard daylight; no extra effects.

root_visual_review.notes: Inspected bearded man in long robe wearing horned cap (horns on cap, not body); two restrained water streams emerge from shoulders into pool. Daylit city staging, no glowing magic. Fits c02/c03.
